email_body:
Hi,

I saw your post looking for a social media manager to bring structure to your content and turn a solid following into real growth. That's exactly the kind of problem I like solving.

In two sentences: I'd start with a content calendar and a clear posting rhythm per platform, then use SEO-driven keyword and trend research to decide what actually gets made. From there I'd run and test campaigns and ads, build reusable CapCut templates, and engage with your community daily so reach compounds instead of stalling.

My background is digital marketing with a technical edge - SEO, content, analytics, and AI tools that automate the repetitive parts. I've built and optimized sites, run SEO audits, and worked with Google Analytics, Search Console, and Google Ads. I'm comfortable across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok, and I learn fast.

I'd love to hear more about the perks and where you want this to go.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your post caught my attention because it describes a problem I recognize well: good content going out without the marketing structure around it to make it grow. You have a solid following but no rise, and you want someone to manage the content, run campaigns and ads, handle thumbnails, and engage with followers. That is the work I want to do.

My background is digital marketing with a technical foundation. At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. At Knowledge Experts I built WordPress sites from structure to content and social media integration, and ran SEO analyses and performance reports. On mirook.com I implemented structured data, knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO and GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. I also write Python scripts and use AI tools and agents to automate repetitive work, which keeps output consistent when there are many platforms to feed.

For your setup, I would start by building a content calendar and a clear posting rhythm for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok, so publishing stops being ad hoc. I would use keyword and trend research to decide what gets made, run and test campaigns and ads, create reusable CapCut templates as an affiliate, and engage with your community daily so reach compounds. I would report on what works and adjust.

I am fluent in English, native in Turkish, and based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium. I would be glad to talk through how I would approach your channels and what the role could look like.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
